description: Image Description: The image shows a rectangular traffic sign with a white background and a red border. At the top, there is a symbol of a bicycle inside a red circle with a diagonal line through it, indicating 'no bicycles.' Below the symbol, the text reads "NO BICYCLE PARKING" in bold black capital letters. At the bottom, there is a black arrow pointing to the left, and beneath it, the text "TOW AWAY ZONE" is written in white letters
